description: Open the OIYO practice office for a country and room: tax, labor (employment), admin (permits, renting, consumer, customs), legal (registry, court costs, limitation, family, inheritance) trade (customs, small-parcel import duty and VAT: open for KR, JP, UK, CA) or plan (saving, pensions, loans); the Korea floor also has insurance (claims, medical expense cover, car accidents), realty (brokerage, renting, buying, registration), biz (start-up, franchise) and welfare (benefits, medical costs, care). Returns the five intake questions that change the answer, the calculators and checkers (with their MCP tool names), the Claude skills and the free official help for that room. Leave out room to list the rooms with tool counts. Start here when you do not know which tool fits. General information only; no advice, representation or filing.

audience.description: Only tools for clients (public) or practitioners (pro); leave out for both

lang.description: Language for room names and intake questions (default en)
